title_en: New Slang, New Stories (1/20): What Exactly Is "996"?
note_en: The pattern 越……越…… means "the more ..., the more ...": 小伟越看越生气 "the more Xiao Wei read, the angrier he got." Unlike English, there's no "the" and no comparative ending; you just put 越 before each verb or adjective, and the subject comes before the first 越.
